traits.name: Aquatic
traits.description: Possessing gills or another aquatic breathing ability, your character could be an Atlantean, a half-fish hybrid, or some other intriguing sea creature.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: You have the ability to breathe and swim underwater normally for up to 8 hours (as long as your Bulk does not exceed 2).
You have the ability to breathe and swim underwater.
You have the ability to dive into the deepest depths underwater.

traits.name: Fast
traits.description: Whether naturally swift or endowed with elongated legs, your character moves with remarkable celerity.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Double your move distance when spending all Stamina to move.
When rolling for Base Finesse Action Dice, roll two dice instead but choose the highest result.
Whenever you take damage, you can spend 1 Reflex to reduce it by 5.

traits.name: Healthy
traits.description: Blessed with robust health and hardy constitution, your character shrugs off sickness and recovers quickly from wounds, facing adversity with remarkable vitality.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Gain 5 Maximum Health.
When rolling for Base Vitality Action Dice, roll two dice instead but choose the highest result.
The effects of Injury are delayed by 2 more points.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: Whether equipped with wings akin to a bird or flying reptile, or endowed with supernatural means of flight, your character’s trait grants them the ability to soar through the skies.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: You have the ability to glide (when you fall, you can choose to descend 2m per Turn). You must maintain horizontal movement.
You have the ability to fly. You can carry 1 regular-sized creature when flying but your move distance is reduced to half.

Your move distance is no longer affected when carrying 1 regular-sized creature when flying. You have the ability to carry 2 regular-sized creatures when flying but your move distance is reduced to half.

traits.name: Gecko
traits.description: Whether a genuine humanoid gecko or equipped with the wall-climbing prowess of a spider or insect, your character defies gravity with remarkable climbing abilities.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Spend 1 Stamina to stick to walls until your next Turn ends.
You have the ability to Move on any surface by doubling your Stamina cost.
You have the ability to Move on any surface, free of added costs.

traits.name: Jumper
traits.description: Possessing either robust, reverse-jointed legs or exceptionally powerful muscles, your character’s physique grants a unique advantage allowing them to navigate diverse environments with prowess.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your Jump distance increases to 3 meters per 1 Stamina spent. If you move at least 5 meters before jumping, your Jump distance increases to 6 meters per 1 Stamina spent.
Spend 1 Focus to double your Jump distance for the remainder of your Turn.
Spend 3 Focus to triple your Jump distance for the remainder of your Turn.

traits.name: Extra Limbs
traits.description: Sporting extra arms, tentacles, or appendages, your character multitasks with ease, adeptly wielding more weapons, tools, or performing complex actions others can only dream of.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.
traits.limit: You can purchase this Trait multiple times but you can only purchase each option once.

traits.name: Natural Weapons
traits.description: Armed with nature's fury, your character unleashes primal power with razor-sharp claws, crushing horns, or piercing fangs.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.
options: Horns - You have a set of horns. It is a melee weapon that deals 3d6 Blunt damage and has a reach of 1m.
Fangs - You have a set of fangs. It is a melee weapon that deals 4d4 Pierce damage and has a reach of 1m.
Claws - You have a set of claws. It is a melee weapon that deals 2d8 Slice damage and has a reach of 1m.
traits.notes: Your natural weapons are exempted from having Durability and its effects.
traits.limit: You can purchase this Trait multiple times but you can only purchase each option once.

traits.name: Nightsight
traits.description: Whether a catfolk or another hybrid creature, your character possesses the ability to see clearly in the darkness of the night.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: You can clearly see in the dark within 12m.
You can clearly see in the dark within 20m.
You can clearly see in the dark within 60m.

traits.name: Small
traits.description: Naturally diminutive, whether a dwarf, gnome, elf, or pixie, your character harnesses their small stature as an advantage, adeptly utilizing size to navigate challenges with finesse.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.
effects: You are half a meter tall
Decrease all Base Attack Dice against you by 2 sizes, Ignore if Attacker has Small Trait as well

traits.name: Big
traits.description: Imposing in size—tall, broad, or immense—your character dominates the battlefield, using their formidable presence to intimidate foes and overcome physical obstacles.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

traits.name: Durable
traits.description: Whether naturally robust, toughened, or fortified through supernatural means like a psychic barrier or protective film, your character embodies a resilient well-protected nature.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Gain Toughness 2
The First Time in a Mission your Health becomes 0, Gain 1 Health.
The First Time in a Mission your Health becomes 0, Gain 10 Health instead.

traits.name: Resistant
traits.description: Whether naturally resilient or endowed with supernatural traits like scales, natural armor, chitin, or stoneskin, you embody a hardy and robust nature.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.
traits.limit: You can purchase this Trait multiple times but you can only purchase each option once.

traits.name: Regenerative
traits.description: Possessing an uncanny natural healing ability, your character, whether a vampire, werewolf, or another regenerative creature like a plant, jellyfish, or insect, can swiftly mend wounds with remarkable resilience.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: When you gain Health, Roll a 2d4 and add that much Health to the amount you would gain.
After combat, you may convert 1 Focus to 3 Health as many times as you want.
When you lose Health, you may spend 1 Focus to gain 3 Health as many times as you want.

traits.name: Strong
traits.description: Endowed with raw, physical might, your character lifts, pushes, and combats with exceptional power, breaking barriers and opponents with sheer force.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Add a 1d4 Bonus Die to all your Melee Damage Dice.
When rolling for Base Strength Action Dice, roll two dice instead but choose the highest result.
Whenever you hit with a Heavy Attack or a Critical Hit, the target is also Knocked Down if the damage is at least 10.

traits.name: Kinetic
traits.description: Lightning-fast reflexes put your character a step ahead, allowing rapid reactions and split-second maneuvers that leave adversaries struggling to keep up.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your maximum Reflex increases by 2.
Whenever you have leftover Stamina, each point recovers 2 Reflex instead of 1.
You can use Reflex during your Turn.

traits.name: Terrifying Visage
traits.description: With a fearsome face or unnerving appearance, your character unsettles and intimidates foes at a glance, leveraging their looks to instill fear and hesitation.
traits.required: You can purchase base Traits during character creation only.

ranks.effect: Your Base Action Dice increases by 2 whenever you are intimidating someone, but decreases also by 2 whenever you are trying to persuade someone.
Enemies within 3m have a -2 penalty to their Attack Dice against you.
Enemies within 5m have a -2 penalty to their Attack Dice against you instead.
